SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT NVL(WERKS,' ') AS PLANT, NVL(MBLNR,' ') AS LEGACY_GR_NO FROM SAPDEP.ZKEP_GR WHERE 1=1 AND IF_FLAG in ('1','9') GROUP BY NVL(WERKS,' '), NVL(MBLNR,' ')
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'STDW' AS BUYER, 'KA' AS SITE, NVL(MANDT ,' ') AS MANDT , NVL(MBLNR,' ') AS LEGACY_GR_NO, NVL(ZEILE,' ') AS LEGACY_GR_SEQ, NVL(WERKS,' ') AS PLANT, NVL(EBELN,' ') AS LEGACY_PO_NO, NVL(EBELP,' ') AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ, NVL(STATUS,' ') AS STATUS, NVL(LTRIM(TO_CHAR(MATNR),'0'),' ') AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, NVL(WAERS,' ') AS WAERS, NVL(NETPR, 0) AS UNIT_PRICE, NVL(MENGE, 0) AS GR_QTY, NVL(DMBTR, 0) AS GR_AMT, NVL(BUDAT,' ') AS GR_DATE, NVL(MEINS,' ') AS MEINS, NVL(LGORT,' ') AS LGORT, NVL(REMARK,' ') AS REMARK FROM SAPDEP.ZKEP_GR WHERE IF_FLAG IN ('1','9') AND NVL(WERKS,' ') = '$G_RS.PLANT$' AND NVL(MBLNR,' ') = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_NO$' ORDER BY MANDT,WERKS, MBLNR,ZEILE, EBELN,EBELP
UPDATE SAPDEP.ZKEP_GR SET IF_FLAG = '2', IF_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), IF_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') WHERE 1=1 AND IF_FLAG in ('1','9') AND NVL(WERKS,' ') = '$G_RS.PLANT$' AND NVL(MBLNR,' ') = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_NO$'
